papers.title: TARC：时间自适应机器人控制
papers.summary: TARC让策略同时选择控制动作及保持时长，以查询预算约束学习何时重新决策。作者在遥控车、Go1实机和LIBERO中的冻结VLA上报告较少策略查询而保持任务表现。值得关注的是按状态分配反馈频率，而非统一降频；VLA结果仅在仿真验证，查询次数与油门指令变化也不能直接当作实测节能。
papers.whySelected: 较早论文·首次发现；以正式会议身份核验，关注反馈频率与部署成本。 / Older first discovery; verified conference status and a focus on feedback frequency and deployment cost.

prerequisites: 约束MDP与拉格朗日乘子 / Constrained MDPs and Lagrange multipliers

limits: 保持时段内无法即时响应新扰动，且没有显式安全约束。 / Mid-hold disturbances wait until the next decision; no explicit safety constraint.
全部自由度共用一个保持时长。 / All degrees of freedom share one hold duration.
短时实机实验不构成能耗实测；VLA仅在仿真验证。 / Short hardware trials do not measure energy savings; VLA evaluation is simulation-only.
assumptions: 可训练动作及持续时间策略，并设定最大保持时长与查询预算。 / Requires training an action-duration policy with a maximum hold duration and query budget.

papers.summaryEn: TARC jointly selects a control action and its hold duration, learning when to decide again under a query budget. The authors report fewer policy queries while preserving task performance on an RC car, Go1 hardware, and a frozen VLA in LIBERO. The key idea is allocating feedback frequency by state rather than uniformly lowering it. VLA results are simulation-only, and query counts and throttle-command travel are not direct energy measurements.

papers.summary: 把语言模型补充的属性直接压成一个答案，会丢失查询所需的不确定性。本文用ProvSQL将候选值及概率编码为互斥溯源事件，支持文本比较与连接，并以音乐商品和评论演示概率SQL。适合结合经典半环论文阅读；模型分数未经校准，不能把结果概率当作事实正确率。

papers.summaryEn: Collapsing model-generated attributes into one answer loses uncertainty needed by queries. This work encodes candidate values and probabilities as mutually exclusive provenance events in ProvSQL, supporting text comparisons and joins, and demonstrates probabilistic SQL on musical products and reviews. Read alongside the classic semiring paper; uncalibrated model scores do not make result probabilities factual correctness rates.

papers.title: 溯源半环
papers.summary: 为什么同一个查询能同时计算重复次数、可能世界和数据来源？本文把元组标注统一为交换半环：并与投影累加，连接相乘，再用多项式保存推导结构。先读例子与正关系代数，建立理解当日ProvSQL论文的语言；这不是完整SQL或更新修复算法，递归部分需另读其固定点条件。
papers.whySelected: 周一独立经典；获2017 PODS Alberto O. Mendelzon Test-of-Time Award，不计每日新文数量。

li.whyRead: 基础线：先建立溯源代数，再理解当日不确定查询系统。
li.relation: 直接支撑lineage/provenance阅读；不是VKG更新算法。

limits: 本文不提供一般SQL差集、聚合和更新修复的统一现成实现。
assumptions: 正关系代数的元组标注使用交换半环。

papers.summaryEn: Why can one query calculate multiplicities, possible worlds, and provenance? This paper unifies tuple annotations through commutative semirings: union and projection add, joins multiply, and polynomials preserve derivation structure. Start with examples and positive relational algebra to prepare for today’s ProvSQL paper. This is not a complete SQL or update-repair algorithm; recursion requires separate study of its fixed-point conditions.
